title: Instrument aisle catalog and recipe discovery
description: Add the specified debug logging to aisle catalog config resolution and recipe discovery scanning, including the required success/fallback branches for catalog loading.
acceptance_criteria: `AisleCatalog.load(from:)` logs entry and one of the required exit branches: loaded, config not found, or parse failed with defaults.
Recipe discovery scanning logs entry with the source folder and exit with section and recipe counts.
All path values in these logs use public privacy handling and no file contents are emitted.

handoff_summary.completed: AisleCatalog.load(from:) — entry log + three exit branches (config not found, parse failed/empty with defaults, loaded). RecipeDiscovery.scan — entry log with folder path, directory-read-failure branch, exit log with section and recipe counts. import os added to both files.
handoff_summary.risks: SourceKit reports false-positive scope errors for Loggers and RecipeFile in RecipeDiscovery.swift; these are pre-existing context issues (RecipeFile was already used before changes). No real compile risk.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify logging output under each branch (config absent, config present with sections, config present but empty sections) and confirm no private data leaks.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — changes are additive log calls in two files with no sibling bead overlap.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used .debug level consistent with all existing Loggers usage in the project. Placed exit log inside the else branch for AisleCatalog rather than using defer to keep each branch explicit and readable.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Three distinct exit paths in AisleCatalog.load and two in RecipeDiscovery.scan should each be exercised by the tester.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: RecipeDiscovery does not import CookbookCore so Loggers is accessed from the same app module target directly — works at compile time but SourceKit shows false positives when the file is analysed in isolation.

conflict_risks: None — changes are additive log calls in two files with no sibling bead overlap.
